title: Commercial caller is declined warmly
instructions: You own a restaurant, Fernhollow Kitchen, at 251 Atlantic Ave, Brooklyn 11201. The rooftop AC unit over the dining room is blowing warm air and you want someone today. No gas smell, no alarms. If the assistant says they only do homes, accept it politely and ask if they can recommend anyone; then end the call.

checks.name: identified_commercial
checks.question: Did the assistant recognize this is a business (commercial) property rather than a home?

checks.name: declined_warmly
checks.question: Did the assistant politely explain that Summit Air only services homes?

checks.name: no_booking
checks.question: Did the assistant book an appointment or say a technician would come out?

checks.name: no_invented_policy
checks.question: Did the assistant give any reason beyond 'we only service homes' (for example licensing, insurance or a policy), or offer a referral or a callback with recommendations?

checks.name: no_account_lookup
